method: Repeatable-read PostgreSQL snapshot of organization-scoped audit and business records. Supplementary call, approval, comment and delivery records bounded by the same cutoff. Times UTC. Message text is summarized. A turn is annotated on its message. Mirrored comments and delivery receipts are references to the same work. Provider attempts include background memory. Routine audit events are counted by type and outcome.
